source: Valve item definitions, dota/scripts/npc/items.txt (github.com/dotabuff/d2vpkr, master, fetched 2026-10-24): items whose AbilityBehavior has DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_IGNORE_CHANNEL
note: Using any other item, casting an ability or moving interrupts a channel such as the Town Portal Scroll. An item's effect after the cast (a self-silence, an invisibility break) can still end it.
